capabilities: Recommend existing tags for the current note or all notes
Reorganize all notes from a single command
Move root notes into existing top-level folders when confidence is high
Move root images into an Assets or custom folder
Edit tag and directory LLM prompts or restore defaults
extras: README warns that note content is sent to the configured API and recommends a local LLM for private notes; states the plugin has no telemetry and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to automatically apply existing tags or file root-level notes into folders based on note content.

relations.evidence: organizes notes with your existing tags and an OpenAI-compatible LLM

summary: LLM-powered organizer that recommends tags from a note's existing tag set and optionally files root notes into top-level folders.
